description: Use this when an agent must screen a person, entity, or crypto/Lightning/x402 payee against US OFAC and UK sanctions or check counterparty reputation. kind="intuitive" (default): match check; kind="stats": hit details; kind="pro": both (BitScore 0-100; clear/possible_match/match); kind="signals": pre-payment screen (do_not_pay/review/ok/unknown; pass address/pay_to, invoice, ln_address, node, domain, url, or business). Unknown does not mean safe. Returns JSON `data` with attribution. Kinds: intuitive (5 sats or $0.003 USDC), stats (8 sats or $0.005 USDC), pro (17 sats or $0.01 USDC), signals (8 sats or $0.005 USDC). Pay: L402 (`l402_credential`), x402 (`x402_payment`), or `credit_token` (https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay, bittuitive://guide/pricing). Info only; not financial/legal advice; no warranty.
